newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas prices mixed but only three trades done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas prices mixed but only three trades done.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract was mixed on Friday morning, with prices moving in a narrow range but only three trades concluded.

Front-month May saw a single 25-lot deal at 10.225 pence a therm, off by 0.025 pence from Thursday's settlement level. And June was up by 0.01 pence to 10.255 pence a therm by the close of the morning session, although trade was also slim, with only two deals done totalling 35 lots.
On most other months, bids and offers stood on either side of the previous settlement price by the midday end of the session.
IPE futures brokers had expected the market to open unchanged on Friday morning following a thin day on Thursday, when only 70 lots were traded at mostly stable levels.
